jobs.description: TL;DR: Lovable's growth marketing runs on creative. The volume, variety, and quality of concepts we put in front of people, and how fast what we learn from them turns into the next round. Your job is to own that loop end to end, constantly iterating on it to achieve the best results against your KPIs. PLEASE NOTE: This role is based in London, United Kingdom. It is not eligible for remote work. We are unable to support work authorization in the UK at this time. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. What we’re looking for - You've run high-volume creative testing on performance marketing and can talk specifically about what you learned, not just what you shipped. - You use AI tools daily and have built something with them that other people now depend on. A workflow, an agent, an internal tool, a tagging pipeline. - You have opinions about what makes an ad work and can articulate them well. - You write well for ads. Briefs, hooks, scripts etc. - You're comfortable being wrong in public. A lot of tests lose, and the loop only works if we’re all comfortable with that. - You move fast, but balance that with exceptional craft and know where the balance is. What you’ll do You'll be the person who decides what we test, why, and what the results mean. Then you'll build the workflows that turn those answers into hundreds of assets a month without losing the taste that made them work in the first place. - Own the creative operating system. You run creative ops for performance marketing: intake, briefing, production, QA, launch, and post-mortem. You'll define how the process works and then automate the parts that don't need a human in the loop. - Be the creative performance decision maker. When we can produce hundreds of creatives, you’ll be the person to judge what we make more of, what gets killed and what to slightly edit. That means holding the creative standard high, and making sure that creatives generated look Lovable. - Build agentic workflows and keep improving them. You'll design pipelines that generate, adapt, and localise creative at volume, with evals to check quality before anything ships. When a workflow breaks, you diagnose it and help rebuild it. - Turn performance data, audience insights and product knowledge into concepts. You'll dig into what's actually driving results, hook, format, message, subject, pacing, offer, and separate the signal from the noise a low-spend winner creates. - Run brainstorms and briefing. You own the rhythm that takes learnings, customer language, competitor moves, product releases, and additional context, and works with the wider team to turn them into briefs. - Push learnings across the company. What wins on paid usually tells us something about the website, lifecycle emails, App Store listings, and organic content. You'll be the one making sure that reaches the relevant people so we become more informed collectively. About your application Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Agencies decide what gets planned, pitched, and bought. This role exists to make X the default recommendation inside those rooms.
You own the agency system and the commercial architecture for Global Brands across APAC. That means holding-company and regional leadership in Singapore and India — and, as a hiring requirement, the Business Directors, Client Directors, and Account Directors who write the plans and clear the buys. A C-suite network without working-level relationships is not sufficient for this role. You will structure commercial deals, navigate complex agency structures, and create the conditions for the sales tea to win more spend.
This is a senior individual-contributor role. You will operate independently, set your own map, and be accountable for agency-sourced revenue influence and partnership quality. You will work as a peer with the Global Brand sales team — close partnership, distinct ownership. This role reports to the Head of Global Brands, APAC.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build and run the agency development plan for Global Brands across APAC — covering holding companies, regional hubs in Singapore and India, operating companies, and key independents.
Develop strategic relationships at two levels, both required:
Structure and negotiate commercial deals with agencies: trading agreements, partnership frameworks, incentives, joint business plans, and other constructs that lock in commitment and unlock spend.
Navigate complex agency structures — holdco vs. opco, regional vs. local P&Ls, media vs. creative vs. social specialists, and split decision rights between Singapore regional teams and in-market India / SEA offices. Know who decides, who influences, who executes, and how a regional recommendation dies or ships in-market.
Act as the primary trusted advisor to priority agencies. Educate teams on X products, audiences, creative, brand safety, and measurement. Arm them to recommend X to their brand clients without you in the room.
Partner with Client Partners and market teams to convert agency relationships into live campaigns, larger statements of work, and multi-market commitments.
Identify whitespace: agencies and pods that should be recommending X and currently are not. Open those doors and create a path to revenue.
Represent X at agency town halls, leadership forums, holding-company reviews, industry events, and in-market working sessions.
Track partnership health and commercial performance. Course-correct quickly. Do not wait for a quarterly review to find out a key agency has gone quiet.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
A self-starter who runs independently. You do not need a playbook handed to you. You build one, socialize it, and execute.
10–12+ years in media sales, agency development, or senior agency-side commercial / client leadership, with a clear record of driving revenue through agency partnerships in APAC.
An existing network you can use immediately — not a list you hope to build. It must already include:
Proven experience structuring commercial deals and working through layered agency decision-making (holding companies, operating companies, local markets, specialist units).
Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. Credible with a regional CEO and useful to a Business Director running a global brand the same week.
Deep understanding of how media, creative, social, and performance agencies plan and buy in APAC.
Comfortable with ambiguity, competing stakeholders, and a fast-moving product environment.
Willingness to travel regularly across Southeast Asia and India.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Southeast Asian language skills preferred — this will materially increase effectiveness in key markets.
Time spent inside a holding-company network (WPP, Publicis, Omnicom, IPG, Dentsu, Havas) or a major independent, plus platform-side agency development.
Direct experience standing up or resetting an agency partnership in a market where the platform was under-indexed.
Working fluency in how global brands brief regional and local agencies across SEA and India.
Experience with both brand and performance agency models.

jobs.description: Are you interested in shaping the future of Advertising and B2B Sales? We are a growing team with an exciting AI-first charter and need your passion, innovative thinking, and creativity to help take our products to new heights. Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing and most profitable businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Our products are strategically important to our businesses driving long term growth. We break fresh ground in product and technical innovations every day! Within the Advertising Sales organization, we are building a central AI/ML team and are seeking top Applied Science talent to help us build new, science-backed services that drive success for our customers. Our goal is to transform the way account teams operate by creating actionable insights and recommendations they can share with their advertising accounts, and ingesting Generative AI throughout their end-to-end workflows to improve their work efficiency. As an Applied Scientist on the team focused on creating customer-facing recommendations related to our advertising products and budget allocations, you will bring deep expertise in quantitative modeling techniques such as Sequential Recommender Systems, Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning or Hidden Markov Models. You have the scientific and technical skills to build and refine models that can be implemented in production, and you leverage Natural Language Processing and Generative AI models to enhance their explainability. You will contribute to chart new courses with our ad sales support technologies, and you have the communication skills necessary to explain complex technical approaches to a variety of stakeholders and customers. You will be part of a team of fellow scientists and engineers taking on iterative approaches to tackle big, long-term problems. You are fluently able to leverage the latest Generative AI systems and services to accelerate and improve your work while maintaining high quality in your work outputs. Key job responsibilities Scientific Modeling - Conceptualize and lead state-of-the-art research on new Machine Learning and Generative Artificial Intelligence solutions to optimize all aspects of the Ad Sales business - Lead the technical approach for the design and implementation of successful models and algorithms in support of expert cross-functional teams delivering on demanding projects - Run regular A/B experiments, gather data, and perform statistical analysis - Improve the scalability, efficiency and automation of large-scale data analytics, model training, deployment and serving - Publish scientific findings in reports and papers that can be shared internally and externally Product Development Support - Partner with software engineering and product management teams to support product and service development, define success metrics and measurement approaches, and help drive adoption of innovative new features for our services. - Lead requirements gathering sessions with product teams and business stakeholders - Maintain scientific documentation and knowledge for product initiatives Collaboration & Communication - Work closely with software engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions into production - Translate complex scientific findings into actionable business recommendations for stakeholders and senior management - Provide clear, compelling reports and presentations on a regular basis with respect to your models and services - Communicate with internal teams to showcase results and identify best practices. About the team Sales AI is a central science and engineering organization within Amazon Advertising Sales that powers selling motions and account team workflows via state-of-the-art of AI/ML services. Sales AI is investing in a range of sales intelligence models, including the development of advertiser insights, recommendations and Generative AI-powered applications throughout account team workflows. We are truly working on the cutting edge of innovation within Deep Learning, RL, Generative AI and Sequential Recommender Systems within the advertising and sales domains.

jobs.description: In the Quantitative Finance division, we provide critical quantitative strategies and solutions for businesses across the Firm to optimize trading tools and processes. The Senior Director, Gilead Patient Solutions Public Affairs, will develop and execute an integrated communications and advocacy strategy that advances company priorities, supports sustainable access to innovation for patients, and strengthens Gilead's reputation across a diverse set of countries. The ideal candidate will bring strong instincts from a complex, regulated, global biotechnology environment and will be comfortable operating across corporate reputation, advocacy, global NGO engagement, internal and external communications, media, issues management and crisis response. jobs.description: Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today! Job Details About Cencora: Cencora is one of the largest drug wholesale and distribution companies in the world. Ranked among the top 10 on the Fortune 500, it serves as a critical link between pharmaceutical manufacturers, healthcare providers, pharmacies, health systems, and patients. Why Join Us: At Cencora, data scientists work on high-impact problems at the intersection of healthcare, supply chain, operations, finance, and strategy. As a Data Scientist Intern, you'll join a team that values curiosity, rigor, and real-world impact. You'll receive mentorship and guidance from experienced practitioners while building your skills across statistics, machine learning, data engineering, and business problem-solving — all in a domain where your work contributes to healthier outcomes for customers and patients. What You Will Do Explore, clean, and prepare structured datasets from internal and external sources to support analysis and modeling efforts. Build, test, and validate statistical and machine learning models under the guidance of senior team members — applying established methods to well-defined business problems. Support data pipeline development and maintenance tasks — including data extraction, transformation, and loading. Assist with model deployment, testing, and monitoring activities in production environments. Create documentation that communicates findings, methodology, and recommendations to technical and business audiences. Collaborate with other data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to contribute to team deliverables and project milestones. Follow team standards for code quality, version control, reproducibility, and responsible use of data — including privacy, fairness, and compliance with enterprise governance requirements. Participate in team knowledge-sharing sessions and pursue continuous learning to deepen your technical and domain expertise. What You Bring Ability to explain your analyses and results clearly, especially within familiar contexts. A learning mindset — genuine curiosity about data science methods, business problems, and the healthcare and supply chain domains. Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and a collaborative working style. What You Will Learn: This role is designed to accelerate your growth as a data scientist. At Cencora, you'll gain hands-on experience that builds the foundation for a long, impactful career: Real-world problem framing — how to take a vague business question and turn it into a well-scoped analytical plan with clear success criteria. Production-grade coding practices — including version control workflows, code review norms, and writing clean, reproducible code that teams can build on. Healthcare and supply chain domain knowledge — developing the contextual understanding that separates a good analyst from a trusted advisor. Stakeholder communication — how to present technical findings to non-technical audiences in ways that are clear, credible, and actionable. Modern data science tooling and infrastructure — including cloud-based platforms, large-scale data environments, model deployment pipelines, and the team's analytics and engineering stack. Required Qualifications Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in data science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Foundational programming skills in Python and SQL. Understanding of core statistical concepts (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression, probability) and introductory machine learning techniques. Experience preparing and working with data, including cleaning, transformation, and quality assessment through coursework, internships, or projects. Familiarity with version control concepts (e.g., Git). Preferred Qualifications Internship or project experience involving applied analytics, data science, or machine learning. Exposure to healthcare, pharmaceutical, supply chain, or logistics domains. Exposure to cloud-based data platforms or modern analytics ecosystems (e.g., Databricks, Azure). What Success Looks Like Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality analyses and models that contribute to team goals. You'll earn trust by learning quickly, asking thoughtful questions, and being thorough and reliable. At Cencora, we measure data science not just by technical skill, but by the value it creates in service of healthier futures.
